name: composed-chart
title: Composed chart
description: Bars and lines on one plot, with an optional second value axis, for a figure and its rate.

when: A count and a rate over the same periods, e.g. orders and conversion.

builtIn: A "Show as table" button shows the same data as a table, which screen readers get by default.
youProvide: A title that says what the figure is.
